newsitem.title: USA: Duke Energy to meet with LADWP manager nominee.
newsitem.headline: Duke Energy to meet with LADWP manager nominee.

text.p: Officers of Duke Energy Corp's unregulated power marketing unit will meet today with David Freeman, who has been nominated to head the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP), an official at the municipal utility said Tuesday.
The meeting is expected to clarify Freeman's opinion of LADWP's proposed strategic alliance with Duke.

In February, LADWP chose the Duke unit--at that time a joint venture between Duke and Louis Dreyfus Natural Gas Corp --to partner with as California begins to allow open competition between electricity suppliers.
But the proposed alliance, a three year agreement to help LADWP beef up trading revenues and retain large customers, has yet to be approved by the City Council.
Meanwhile Duke, which merged with natural gas marketer and pipeline company PanEnergy in June, bought out Louis Dreyfus' share in the power marketing venture.
"That did cause a delay. (LADWP) had to do some due diligence, but the new company is as strong or even stronger than Duke-Louis Dreyfus," Duke spokesman Randy Wheeless said.
But Duke wants to make sure Freeman, who is expected to take over as general manager of LADWP in September, is committed to the project, he noted.
"We are still very much interested in pursuing the business. But we don't want to waste our time or their time on something that might not happen," Wheeless added.
He noted Duke has the option of withdrawing from the project at any time.
